title: Chapter 971
text:
The same theory would often lead to different technologies. A Universal Civilization did not mean that they were omniscient and omnipotent. Just like how the three Universal Civilizations did not have their own unique technologies, the diversity of the civilizations also ensured the diversity of the technology tree.

Han Xiao was very familiar with the special technology that the Kunde Race had displayed. This was a technology known as Spacetime Splicing, which came from a branch of spacetime theory.

Spacetime technology was very advanced but not rare. The three Universal Civilizations and even the various Star Cluster Civilizations would more or less know some of it. Even in the Super system of the Mages, there were spacetime related spells. For example, Lagi's' Smash Varudo 'was one of them.

However, Spacetime Splicing also had its own uniqueness.

The three Universal Civilizations did not reveal the specific principles behind it in his previous life, and Han Xiao only had a rough idea. This Spacetime Splicing seemed to be an ability to travel through spacetime, but it was also very different.

The way Han Xiao saw it, the reason the Kunde Race fleet was able to recover time and time again was because they had used Spacetime Splicing to freeze the fleet in the state before it was destroyed. No matter how many times it was destroyed, it would be able to recover to its previous state.

The movement of the fleet was another use of Spacetime Splicing. First, a trend of the fleet was set as a parameter and simulated in reality, building a spacetime model of the entire action from start to end. Then, it broke through the spacetime continuum and separated the continuous action model into many time points. To put it simply, it was turning the action of 'I want to do something' into a movie, and every time point was a frame of the movie.

Then, he took out the time chain of this preset behavior and locked his own space-time in it, cutting off the past and future, and only existing in the "present" of this time chain. He would jump at the time points separated by multiple time spans in the behavior model, and the movement process in the middle would be omitted. It would look like frame skipping. Because there was no process, the normal attacks of the dynasty's fleet would not be able to stop the Kunde Race fleet.

To put it simply, the fleet would transform into a high PING warrior and move forward in a staggered manner. Even if the enemy hit the fleet, it would only hit the previous' me '.

This technology had many unique uses in many aspects, but it was not without side effects. The spacetime axis of the main universe was a chain system that was so huge that it could not be calculated. No matter which point there was an abnormal change, it would be corrected in the end like a taut chain.

For example, all kinds of space-time delay and space-time stop spells would quickly correct the distorted space-time in the area they covered after the effects of the spells ended, allowing the space-time coefficient to return to normal. Only the changed state of matter would remain, and the space-time axis itself would not be affected.

The side effect of Spacetime Splicing was that the spacetime axis would start to correct the spacetime continuum.

Due to the forceful distortion of the space-time attributes of these skipped objects, their state of existence had changed. It was equivalent to half a projection, which would constantly accelerate the collapse of both space-time and matter.

When the correction ability of the spacetime axis caught up to them, all the time points of the entire behavior model would collapse, and the entire timeline of the behavior model would disappear. Their existence would be wiped out like a bubble that had been popped, as though they had never existed in this world.

They would be fixed on a timeline, and after completing the preset goal of the behavior model, they would also automatically disappear. Originally, the spacetime axis was a straight line that extended endlessly, but they had taken a segment from the spacetime axis and jumped from the spacetime axis to the segment. Their lives would only be left with the process of the segment from the start to the end.

This meant that when this technology was used, the fleet would have already 'died' and become ghosts that could disappear at any time.

"I remember that when the three Universal Civilizations used this technology in my previous life, they were equipped with a large number of spacetime stabilizing anchors and many auxiliary devices. Only then could they greatly delay the time of the collapse. If the dynasty obtained this technology from the Kunde Race, then with the dynasty's technology, they would definitely have improved it over the course of several versions. Therefore, based on these two reasons, the Spacetime Splicing Technology in the hands of the Kunde Race should only be the most crude version 1.0. The side effects are more severe, and it's easier to deal with it."

Han Xiao's expression changed slightly, and he pondered in his heart.

Being attacked by the natives during the exploration should have only caused trouble for the dynasty, but now, the dynasty could even obtain a very good spoil of war.

He did not know if the stowaways who secretly gave the technology to the natives knew that the Kunde Race had this technology. Although the stowaways had investigated the strength of the Kunde Race before giving the technology, the Spacetime Splicing Technology was definitely a highly confidential technology of the Kunde Race and would not be discovered so easily.

Stowaways into the Flickering World were no different from suicide squads. Those Supercluster or Star Cluster Civilizations would not send Calamity Grade Supers to carry out such a mission, so the stowaways would not have too many people.

"If they don't know, then they would have suffered a huge loss. They wanted to drag the dynasty down but ended up giving them a treasure instead."

Han Xiao chuckled in his heart.

On the other side, Tarrokov also did not rest and quickly made his arrangements.

As an experienced officer, Tarrokov had seen all kinds of situations. Although he did not know the theory behind the Spacetime Splicing Technology, since the alarm said that it was a spacetime issue, he would make use of the corresponding means. The dynasty's assets were more than enough to deal with all kinds of sudden situations.

Very quickly, a dynasty fleet that was on standby on Planet Lighthouse set off. They were equipped with a large number of spacetime Mages who were proficient in spacetime spells to intercept the Kunde Race fleet.

Normal attacks were useless, and spacetime spells were able to affect the Kunde Race fleet to a certain extent.

After the second dynasty fleet entered the battlefield, the situation quickly changed. The various spacetime spells and spacetime devices allowed the Kunde Race fleet to travel slower and slower. The white noise on the surface of the Kunde Race fleet also became denser and denser, which meant that the speed of the Kunde Race fleet's collapse was increasing.

Everyone calmly observed the situation in the command room.

After resisting for a period of time, when they were about an hour away from Planet Lighthouse, the Kunde Race fleet disappeared for the last time and did not appear again. A surge of energy burst out of nowhere and spread far and wide in the universe.

There were no intense scenes, and the Kunde Race fleet was annihilated just like that. Apart from the huge amount of energy released after the collapse, nothing was left behind.

In the universe, even annihilation was nothing. However, when these people made up their minds, they must have felt rather tragic. Even though they knew that they were going to die, they still wanted to give the dynasty a beating … Han Xiaoxin shook his head as such a thought flashed through his mind.

"It's settled?" Tarrokov placed his hands on the table with uncertainty.

"Chief commander, the spacetime coefficient has returned to normal. There are no abnormalities with the radar, and we did not detect any enemies."

"Hmm … this might be the side effect of the enemy's technology, and it shouldn't be perfected yet. Before we can confirm that the enemy is completely annihilated, do not let your guard down. Continue to scan the surrounding area. Also, activate the planetary shield of Planet Lighthouse. At the same time, keep all emergency escape routes open. If the enemy suddenly appears around the planet, we will be able to evacuate quickly. "

Tarrokov swiftly made the arrangements. Because he did not understand the enemy, he did not dare to let his guard down.

However, Han Xiao knew that the enemy was already dead. He narrowed his eyes and thought to himself, In my previous life, the dynasty also obtained this technology from the Kunde Race, but I did not have any news about it. This means that the dynasty has implemented very strict confidentiality measures and should not allow their allies to exchange for this technology … Hmm, so I will have to obtain the Spacetime Splicing Technology myself.

It was rare for him to encounter such a powerful technology, and Han Xiao was tempted.

Coincidentally, the dynasty still did not know the theory behind the Spacetime Splicing Technology, and he could take advantage of the fact that the dynasty was not paying much attention to it.

He might not be able to use it himself, but the members of the Black Star Corps might be able to use it under certain circumstances. Furthermore, not only could this technology be used on his own people, but it could also be used on his enemies.

He wondered if the Spacetime Amber and Spacetime Splicing Technology would work together and what kind of effect would it produce … Han Xiao was a little curious.

…

In the depths of the Dust Light Star Cluster, an enormous Kunde Race fleet was slowly moving through the universe.

In the conference room of the flagship, the upper echelons of the Kunde Race were seated.

When they realized that the Red Empire was heading toward their territory, the upper echelons had decisively left their mother planet and moved together with the fleet.

Since most of their race had already been transported away, they did not need to hesitate to temporarily give up on the colonial planet that they had been building for many years.

"We have lost contact with Yelu's fleet. The ambush plan has failed."

"Are they all dead?"

"We can't be sure, but they should have used the Spacetime Splicing Technology."

"This means that even the Spacetime Splicing Technology is unable to deal with the Red Empire …"

Hearing the report of one of the upper echelons, everyone present was solemn.

The Kunde Race leader remained silent for a moment before slowly saying, "Let's use the scorched earth plan."

Hearing that, everyone's expression changed.

They had come up with many battle plans, and the scorched earth plan was their last resort. They had originally planned to only use it when they were certain that they would lose. However, they did not expect their leader to be so aggressive and use it right away.

Thinking about it, the upper echelons present did not have much confidence in this battle. The main reason why they had stayed behind to fight was that they were not willing to give up their home to the bandits without any resistance. They also did not want the Red Empire to take over their home without paying any price.

The scorched earth plan was to make use of the Primordial Psionic Energy's ability to expand infinitely and use it to destroy many Star Systems, including their old home, so that the Red Empire would not be able to obtain anything. They would then retreat and chase after their race.

However, personally destroying their old home was something that they could not accept psychologically.

Sweeping his gaze around, the Kunde Race leader saw that no one spoke.

"Since no one has any objections, let's begin the arrangements. As for the Red Empire's troops approaching … send out a fleet to engage them and stall for time. Slowly let them enter our territory and enter the range of the scorched earth plan …"

Everyone had a heavy heart. There was no turning back now that their home had been destroyed.

The scorched earth plan required time and preparation. If they were to send out a fleet to engage the dynasty head-on, it would mean that many of their comrades would die on the frontlines.

…

A few days after the sneak attack on Planet Lighthouse, more Kunde Race fleets appeared and began to engage in battle with the dynasty's troops that had infiltrated deep into the Dust Light Star Cluster.

The army led by Teny also encountered more and more enemies.

There was no lack of opportunities to fight, but what made Han Xiao feel helpless was that Teny was too good at fighting. Under his command, the fleet's coordination was extremely smooth, and they could easily end the battle from afar. There were not many opportunities for them to engage in close combat.

Furthermore, Teny even consciously protected the members of the Black Star Corps, which made Nero feel even worse. After running around with the army for almost a month, Nero had not even touched the hands of a Kunde Race soldier.

If this continued, Han Xiao would not be able to hold himself back from invading the next wave of enemies and controlling the Kunde Race to attack Teny.

Thankfully, Teny did not allow Han Xiao to extend his claws so quickly. In another battle, the Black Star Corps finally took on the task of engaging in close combat.

Nero finally welcomed his first time.
